title: RECURSIVE RECKONING // YOU ARE TRAPPED IN 2011 FOREVER
narrative: The parchment turns transparent. The ink begins to flow backwards into the bottle. A cold chill grips your spine as you realize the terrifying truth: there is no conclusion. The Winds of Winter is not a novel—it is a mathematical Gödelian loop designed to trap human consciousness in the summer of 2011 for eternity. You will debate Jon Snow's parentage forever. You will re-read The Forsaken forever. George smiles from behind his typewriter: 'Just three more chapters, guys. Almost done.'
resolvesPlotHole: The Manuscript Cannot Be Finished By Mathematical Law

options.text: Let George hold down the WordStar backspace key in Santa Fe.
Reboot the universe from chapter one at the Wall.
